why_ai: Writers and supervisors choose publishers on relationships and creative ears, but registration, collection and statement work is software and agent territory.
why_clarity: Royalties collected are measurable and administration repeats, but which song to sign or pitch is taste paid months later.
why_digital: Songs, metadata and contracts are digital and licences go out remotely, but writers are signed and supervisors courted in person.

why_ai: Each bid is a novel, high-stakes forecast on a catalogue, and sellers and estates pick buyers on trust as well as price.
why_clarity: The price is exact but whether it was right shows only after years of earnings, and every buyer models decay differently.
why_digital: Statements and models are digital, but catalogues are won through negotiation and relationships with sellers.

why_ai: Supervisors call the reps whose taste they trust, though retrieval, clearance status and quoting automate.
why_clarity: A brief ends in a licence or not, many times a year, but how a rep picks the song is not written down.
why_digital: Briefs, audio and licences move by email and platform, while supervisor relationships are built in person.

why_ai: The rep's read of what a supervisor will license is personal taste and relationship, which buyers pay for.
why_clarity: Good pitching is judged by feel, and silence after a pitch leaves most outcomes unlabelled.
why_digital: Briefs and playlists are digital, but the supervisor relationships that win placements are personal.

why_ai: Approval routing, fee matching and status tracking automate; the remaining work is negotiating with co-owners.
why_clarity: A song clears for a use at a fee or it does not, quickly and many times over.
why_digital: Quotes, approvals and licences are digital documents exchanged remotely between companies.

why_ai: Lawyers serve and contest termination notices under a statute, with high stakes and real ambiguity in old grants.
why_clarity: The statute fixes the windows and the calculation is rule-based, but disputes over grants resolve years later.
why_digital: Agreements are read on screen and notices recorded with the Copyright Office, with work routed through counsel.

why_ai: Gap detection and claim filing are data work agents can do, with sub-publisher relationships the remaining protection.
why_clarity: Money recovered is measurable and claims repeat by territory, but statements and outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Usage data, statements and claims are digital and handled remotely with partners abroad.

why_ai: Writers stay for the creative relationship, but earnings estimates and statement explanations are software work.
why_clarity: Estimates can be checked against statements when they land, across many recurring writer questions.
why_digital: Usage and statement data are digital, while writers are signed and served through in-person creative relationships.

why_ai: Standard arrangement permissions follow rules a licensing engine can apply instantly.
why_clarity: A licence for a given ensemble, use and term is an exact, repeatable deliverable.
why_digital: Requests and licences are handled online, sometimes alongside printed parts.

why_ai: Classifying conflicts and assembling evidence automate, leaving the occasional ambiguous chain of title for a person.
why_clarity: A conflict is resolved for one party or the other, across thousands of similar cases.
why_digital: Conflict notices, documents and portal filings are all digital.

why_ai: Statement ingestion, matching and split application are pipeline work AI absorbs, with audit exposure keeping a reviewer.
why_clarity: Every line posts to the right account or not, in huge recurring volume, checkable by audit.
why_digital: Statement files in, writer statements and payments out, bought as software or outsourced remotely.

why_ai: Named valuers sign reports that auditors, lenders and rating agencies rely on, and disputes over marks need an accountable firm.
why_clarity: Hundreds of same-shaped valuations a year, but accuracy is known only as the catalogue earns.
why_digital: Statements in, valuation reports out, delivered remotely to funds, lenders and buyers.

why_ai: Accountants sign audit claims and testify, and statement disputes persist whatever tools publishers adopt.
why_clarity: Contract terms make most findings checkable, though settlements are negotiated and slow.
why_digital: Statements and records reviewed on screen, with clients found through music-business relationships.

why_ai: Collective licensing is structural and regulated, so societies persist even as matching and distribution automate.
why_clarity: Distribution rules are codified and run every quarter, but whether money reached the right owner surfaces slowly.
why_digital: Usage reports and distributions are digital, while licences are still sold to local venues and businesses.

why_ai: Fingerprint detection is automated already; the asset is the reference library and coverage.
why_clarity: A detection matches a work or not, millions of times a month.
why_digital: Broadcast audio in, detection reports out, sold remotely to societies worldwide.

why_ai: Licensed feeds and chart status make it a shared scoreboard AI cannot recreate, though the analytics automate.
why_clarity: Weekly consumption counts per title are objective and repetitive.
why_digital: Data feeds in, charts and dashboards out by subscription.

why_ai: Attribution against improving generators is novel and contested, but it is model work rather than personal accountability.
why_clarity: There is no agreed ground truth for which works a model learned from, so results are hard to verify.
why_digital: Audio and model outputs in, attribution reports out, entirely online.

why_ai: Statutory designation makes it the accountable collector, though its matching work is highly automatable.
why_clarity: Monthly matching and distribution follow regulation and repeat at enormous volume.
why_digital: Usage reports in, distributions and a public database out, all online.

why_ai: Claiming inside a platform's matching system is rule work the platform itself increasingly automates.
why_clarity: Claims are upheld or released, across millions of near-identical cases.
why_digital: Platform claims and reports handled entirely online.

why_ai: Church relationships and a trusted blanket licence sustain it, while reporting and distribution automate.
why_clarity: Licence tiers and usage-based distributions follow fixed rules each year.
why_digital: Licences sold and usage reported online, with some outreach through church networks.

why_ai: Underwriting royalty streams is data-heavy and automatable, with credit judgment and borrower trust remaining.
why_clarity: Advances recoup or not, with outcomes visible over a few years of statements.
why_digital: Statements in, offers and payments out, mostly online.

why_ai: Internal forecasting and reporting on owned catalogues is analysis AI accelerates, with acquisition judgment remaining.
why_clarity: Forecasts are graded by later earnings, slowly, and methods vary by owner.
why_digital: Statements and usage data analysed on screen for internal and investor reporting.

why_ai: Regulated rating agencies must have accountable analysts sign each rating on a young asset class.
why_clarity: Rating criteria are documented, but performance is known only as deals season.
why_digital: Models and documents in, ratings published remotely to investors.

why_ai: Lobbying, litigation and rate-case representation depend on accountable people and member trust.
why_clarity: Annual statistics follow fixed methods, but policy outcomes are slow and contested.
why_digital: Data and filings are digital, while lobbying and member relations happen in person.

why_ai: Only the statutory judges can set the rates, after adversarial proceedings with high stakes.
why_clarity: Each proceeding weighs contested economic evidence, and the effects of a rate are known years later.
why_digital: Filings and determinations are digital, with hearings among a fixed set of participants.

why_ai: Courts hear a named expert's testimony, and each infringement comparison is novel and adversarial.
why_clarity: Similarity judgments vary by expert, and verdicts arrive years later.
why_digital: Recordings and scores are analysed on screen, but testimony is given in court and work comes through counsel.

why_ai: Directors and showrunners hire a supervisor's taste and relationships, which AI raises rather than replaces.
why_clarity: Each project's music is a creative judgment, with no objective test of the right choice.
why_digital: Music is chosen and licensed digitally, but supervisors win work through face-to-face industry relationships.
